name: ashley-desktop-assistant
description: macOS desktop voice assistant with a 3D avatar
author: Zenojz

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-resources.cjs && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && node scripts/bundle-renderer.cjs
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64
scripts.package:mac:zip: pnpm run package:mac && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent release/mac-arm64/Ashley.app release/Ashley-mac-arm64.zip
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/spoken-hide-test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/spoken-music-test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/spoken-conflicts-test.mjs

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ashley 需要使用麦克风来识别唤醒词并进行语音对话。
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Ashley 需要控制 macOS 桌面来执行你明确要求的桌面切换。
